# Issue

Thanks for taking the time to report something about **Ditch Community Edition**.

Use Issues for concrete, actionable problems or well-scoped improvements.

For questions, workflows, broader ideas, architecture discussions, feedback, or ideas that are still exploratory, please use **GitHub Discussions** instead.
